title: Consume proactive runs with quiet-hour delivery
goal: Wire validated owner-configured triggers into serve and the existing planner with durable once-only delivery
acceptance: Serve re-reads validated explicit opt-in trigger configuration; no model work runs without it
Runtime consumes durable runs through existing Misato loop, including failure, approval, restart and cancellation paths
Quiet hours defer new proactive notification delivery without delaying reminder/inbox deliveries already due
Per-trigger steps and actions are bounded; nonproduction writes never execute; source/taint stays durable
Process/browser/channel/native regressions establish actual integration and parent closure evidence
Use configured local planner route without automatic cloud fallback; bind named pilot model/stage and revalidate changed authority at each effect
Publish proactive outcomes as source-tagged Hyuga briefs with their own identities; daily-brief checkpoints and already-due reminders remain unaffected
Defer new proactive approval notices/cards during quiet hours while retaining owner inspection and current TTL/decision authority
Reserve planner-call steps durably before model dispatch so approval/restart never resets a run budget
privacy: Neutral invented definitions/events and local temporary SQLite only; no live models, external integrations, host activation or untrusted code.
validation: Quiet-hour crossing with due reminders and delivery deduplication
Required full CI and independent report-only review before closing P1
NERV golden ledger/conversation/channel/base groups now select watch admission/runtime and quiet/dispatch regressions; system pack1.2 and generated capability index retain source-qualified coverage.
